acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent mode.
alkylation reagent: Search criteria used were trypsin digestion, variable modifications set as carbamidomethyl (C)
cleavage agent: the molecular weight of monoubiquitin was excised for in-gel digestion with Asp-N at 37 °C for overnight.
collision energy: Fragmentation was performed with normalized collision energy of 35%
enrichment method: ubiquitinated Flag-VPS34 was isolated by immunoprecipitation with anti-Flag M2 beads
fractionation method: the Lbpro*-treated reaction was separated by SDS-PAGE
fragmentation method: The ten most intense ions were sequentially isolated for HCD MS/MS fragmentation
instrument: The mass of intact proteins was determined using Waters Synapt G2 HDMS mass spectrometer
reduction reagent: treated with 50 µM Lbpro* in a buffer containing 50 mM Tris (pH 8.0) and 10 mM DTT
reduction concentration: treated with 50 µM Lbpro* in a buffer containing 50 mM Tris (pH 8.0) and 10 mM DTT
